proved_results: For any physical cross block B of exact rank r>=3, the full quadratic form with arbitrary same-side blocks and outside couplings has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= [2r/(r-2)] (product of nonzero singular values of B)^(-1/r).
For exact-rank-three A=R Lambda R^T with min|lambda|>=1 and delta=max row leverage<1/sqrt(6), ||p_Q||_infinity <=12/(1-sqrt(6)delta), continuously.
At delta<=2/5, the preceding constant is 300+120sqrt(6)<594.

If delta>=1/sqrt(6), then either |A_ii|>=1/8 for a heavy row, which is paid by the existing affine half-Riesz theorem, or that row has ||A[i,-i]||_2>0.6265965930, a fixed-scale near-null hub certificate.
